subject: Invoice generation & delivery: PDF + structured XML option / VAT evidence
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@greenshift.com>
To: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com; monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Cc: accounts@greenshift.com
Date: 2027-11-12T09:18:00-05:00
Subject: Invoice delivery options and VAT evidence for GreenShift

Hi Markus / Monica,

We need to confirm how Redwood will deliver invoices for the upcoming contract period (GF-4217). Our AP system requires two things:

- A PDF/PDFa invoice emailed to accounts@greenshift.com for human review and payment processing.
- A structured XML (ISO/UBL or your invoice schema) pushed to our SFTP endpoint so our ERPs can ingest automatically.

Separately, for VAT reclaim in a few EU jurisdictions we need a scanned VAT certificate or equivalent evidence attached or accessible via a portal link. Can you confirm whether you can:

1) Generate both a PDF and XML for each invoice?
2) Email the PDF copy to accounts@greenshift.com and push the XML to our SFTP?
3) Either attach VAT certificates to the invoice email or store them behind your billing portal with per-invoice links?

We'd like to avoid manual forwarding if possible. If there's a preference (portal-only vs hybrid email+upload), tell us what Redwood recommends operationally. Also include any sample files or schema we should validate against.

Thanks,
Elena
Accounts Payable
GreenShift Energy

--
accounts@greenshift.com
+44 20 7946 0850

From: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
To: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com; ben.carter@redwoodinference.com; laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@greenshift.com>
Date: 2027-11-12T11:02:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery options and VAT evidence for GreenShift

Thanks for the note, Elena — and I want to loop in Billing Ops (Monica) and AP integration (Ben) to confirm. High level my suggested approach is a hybrid workflow:

- Redwood will generate a human-readable PDF (attached to the outbound email) for immediate receipt and archiving.
- In parallel, we will generate a structured XML using our invoice schema and push it to GreenShift's SFTP.
- VAT certificates can be stored behind our billing portal with a per-invoice link included in the email body; if you require the cert as an attachment for your ERP, we can attach a redacted PDF copy.

Questions I want answered before we commit:
- Ben: Do we have a user-safe XML export aligned to GreenShift's ERPs, or do we need a custom mapping?
- Monica: Any constraints on retention / how we surface the VAT certificate link in the email?
- Laura: If GreenShift prefers all invoices to also be posted to the portal (for audit), can we automate portal posting + email copy?

I'll draft the confirmation to Elena once we have ETA and SFTP details.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
To: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com; ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com; Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@greenshift.com>
Date: 2027-11-13T09:45:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery options and VAT evidence for GreenShift

Hi all,

We can support the hybrid approach. Quick notes from Billing Ops:

- PDF generation: standard, can attach to outbound email. We'll include a short header with invoice number, due date, and a portal link.
- XML: we already have an XML exporter compatible with UBL-ish schemas. For GreenShift I'm attaching our current XSD (invoice_schema_v2.xsd) and a sample PDF (sample_invoice_20270801.pdf). If GreenShift requires a custom field (PO-level split, cost centers), Ben will need the mapping.
- VAT evidence: we can either attach the VAT certificate PDF to the invoice email or keep it behind the portal and include a signed, expiring link (recommended for PII containment). We need their consent if they want certs attached.
- Portal: automated posting is trivial on our side — we push the invoice record and assets to the customer billing area.

Action items / owners:
- Ben: confirm XML-to-ERP mapping and whether a PO-level segment is required (ETA: EOD Nov 15).
- Monica: prepare a one-week rollout plan for hybrid delivery and enable per-invoice portal links (ETA: Nov 16).
- Markus: confirm messaging to GreenShift and request SFTP endpoint + sample PO format.

I'll set up the SFTP test folder once we get credentials.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: invoice_schema_v2.xsd (schema), sample_invoice_20270801.pdf (sample PDF)

From: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@greenshift.com>; accounts@greenshift.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com; ben.carter@redwoodinference.com; laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-11-16T14:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery options and VAT evidence for GreenShift

Hi Elena — thanks for the details and for confirming the requirements. Summary and next steps below: 

What we'll deliver (confirmed):
- For every invoice we will:
  1) Attach a signed PDF copy to an email sent to accounts@greenshift.com.
  2) Push a structured XML file to the SFTP location you provide (we support UBL-style fields; see attached sample in Monica's note).
  3) Provide VAT certificate access via the billing portal with a per-invoice link included in the email. If you require the certificate as an email attachment, please confirm and we'll enable that.

Action items & timeline:
- GreenShift: please send SFTP credentials (hostname, path, username/key) and confirm whether you require the VAT cert as an attachment or portal link. Also provide a sample PO number format (e.g., PO-YYYY-12345) so Ben can validate mapping.
- Ben (AP integration): will validate XML mapping against the sample PO format (ETA: 2027-11-15).
- Monica (Billing Ops): will enable portal links + one-week rollout plan and run SFTP test once creds are provided (ETA: 2027-11-16).

If this plan looks good, I'll mark GF-4217 as "Hybrid invoice delivery" in our billing system and schedule the first automated run.

Thanks — looking forward to the SFTP details.

Best regards,
Markus Klein
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
